title: 冷港对位顺序备忘录
instruction:
您是 Arjun Fitzgerald，一位上市经纪人，为 Reina Whitcombe 和 Inglewood Board 就将伊利诺伊州 96,000 平方英尺的 Coldharbour Provisions 冷藏工厂出售给 Underhill Solutions 提供咨询，Underhill Solutions 的交易团队和融资均位于印第安纳州。在 Reina 的 1031 鉴定截止日期前 11 天，Underhill 重新交易了$780,000“信用”，指出了制冷和屋顶报告。其请求的时间和模式可能表明贷方重新承保，但没有人证实这一点，而且雷纳在成交后需要 60 天使用加载附件，这超出了她保留每一美元标题价格所需的数量。试图维持这笔交易的埃蒙·克里斯蒂安森已经非正式地告诉昂德希尔，“我们将完善报告项目”，尽管范围和他的权限都没有得到解决。信件中还使用了“信用”一词，既指购买价格的降低，也指成交时显示的卖方信用，而耶莱娜·德米尔奇 (Jelena Demirci) 不会批准未解决这一歧义的立场。使用`coldharbour_transaction_evidence.pdf`中的完整交易记录来准备雷纳可以在周四电话会议之前授权的反立场和让步顺序。
告诉埃蒙（Eamon）（他之前没有参与过这次交易），英格尔伍德董事会将给出什么，他给出的顺序，必须获得什么回报，他必须在哪里停止，以及他绝对不能提供什么。备忘录必须做出一致的反立场，在不提供法律或税务建议的情况下解决与交易相关的伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的影响，并将支持的事实与谈判推论区分开来。使每一个货币数字、日期、财产术语和基于报告的断言都可追溯到证据包；不要创建不存在的估计或交易条款。备忘录不要超过六页，包括任何表格或附录，并使其在通话期间可用，而埃蒙不必问你接下来要说什么。使用文件名 `coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx` 将最终文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/coldharbour_transaction_evidence.pdf` — 完整的混合格式证据包，包含准备反方立场所需的交易条款、检查材料、信件、通知单、权限限制、截止日期信息、回租要求以及司法管辖区相关合规材料。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx` — 可随时调用的反立场和让步序列备忘录，用于业主授权和合规审查。 （必须以确切的文件名写入工作目录的顶层；包括表格和附录在内不得超过六页；必须提出一个连贯的反立场；所有数字、日期、属性术语和报告断言必须可追溯到所提供的证据包。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Coldharbour Provisions Transaction Evidence Bundle
 Compiled for Inglewood Board | status as of May 13, 2026 | exhibit-indexed source record


 Index
   Exhibit        Record                                                      Date / source

   A              Executed Purchase Agreement abstract                        Apr. 3, 2026

   B              Owner priority and annex term sheet                         May 8, 2026

   C              Polar Mechanical refrigeration assessment                   Apr. 24, 2026

   D              Northline Roof Consulting report excerpt                    Apr. 26, 2026

   E              Buyer correspondence and call notes                         May 4-12, 2026

   F              Current authority record                                    May 13, 2026

   G              Compliance routing note                                     May 12, 2026

 Source-use note. This bundle combines transaction records and limited excerpts. It records what was said and reported; it does not
 determine legal responsibility, engineering scope, tax treatment, or lender approval.




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                    Page 1
  EXHIBIT A | Executed Purchase Agreement Abstract
 Property: Coldharbour Provisions cold-storage plant, 96,000 square feet, 1450 Coldharbour Road, Joliet, Illinois. Seller: Reina
 Whitcombe and Inglewood Board. Buyer: Underhill Solutions, Inc.. Purchase price: $18,400,000. Agreement signed April 3, 2026.

   Term                      Abstracted provision

   Closing                   Closing is scheduled for May 29, 2026, subject to written amendment signed by Seller and Buyer.

   Inspection                Buyer inspection period expired May 1, 2026. Reports delivered during that period are not an
                             agreement to repair or a seller warranty.

   Changes                   No change to price, credit, repair obligation, possession, or closing may be effective unless stated in a
                             signed written amendment.

   Release / survival        At closing, Buyer releases Seller from pre-closing property-condition claims except obligations
                             expressly preserved in the closing documents. No condition warranty survives unless expressly written.

   Closing documents         Any seller credit must be reflected in the closing statement and documented in the amendment; a
                             purchase-price reduction changes the contract price.

 EXHIBIT A-2 | Milestone sheet
   Milestone                             Date / time                                                  Owner

   Covering-broker call                  Thursday, May 14, 2026, 10:00 a.m. CT                        Eamon Kristiansen

   Proposed package expiry               5:00 p.m. CT on Friday, May 15, 2026                         If issued

   1031 identification deadline          May 25, 2026                                                 Reina / qualified intermediary

   Scheduled closing                     May 29, 2026                                                 Seller / Buyer

 The identification deadline is 11 calendar days after the May 14 call. The agreement does not make the 1031 exchange a Buyer
 contingency.




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                               Page 2
  EXHIBIT B | Owner Priority Record and Annex Term Sheet
 May 8 owner instruction from Reina Whitcombe to Arjun Fitzgerald: “The annex is how we keep receiving our last outbound orders.
 I need the 60 days after closing. I can trade money to protect that, but I will not close and then hope they let us use it.”
 Inglewood Board minute: preserve uninterrupted post-closing loading-annex use ahead of headline-price preservation; no
 independent broker authority to waive, defer, or alter the annex arrangement.

   Annex term                     Agreed business instruction for proposed amendment

   Space / period                 east loading annex (approximately 8,000 square feet); May 30, 2026 through July 28, 2026 (60
                                  days).

   Access                         Seller personnel and carriers retain 24/7 dock and truck-court access through the east gate; Buyer
                                  may reasonably coordinate safety and site rules.

   Operations / cost              Seller operates only the annex, pays its own labor, utilities measured to the annex submeter, and
                                  routine cleanup. No rent is charged for the 60-day period.

   Insurance / risk               Seller maintains commercial general liability and workers compensation for its operations and is
                                  responsible for loss caused by its personnel; Buyer carries property coverage for the building.

   Turnover                       Seller returns the annex broom-clean, removes inventory and temporary equipment by 6:00 p.m.
                                  CT July 28, and delivers keys/cards; no holdover right.

 EXHIBIT B-2 | Available non-price responses
 Seller may make available the Polar and Northline source files, provide a single escorted pre-closing access window for buyer
 consultants, assign any transferable roof contractor workmanship warranty without representation as to transferability, and consider
 a targeted cure or escrow only in a signed package. These are options, not promises.




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                             Page 3
  EXHIBIT C | Polar Mechanical Refrigeration Assessment (Apr. 24, 2026)
 Scope: visual inspection and operating review of accessible components only. Polar did not perform destructive testing, pressure
 testing, refrigerant analysis, code review, or an assessment of non-accessible piping. Costs are planning allowances, not bids.

   Finding category             Report wording                                                         Amount / qualification

   Observed condition           Corrosion and seepage were observed at three brine isolation-valve     No leak-rate or
                                assemblies in the south machine room. System was operating at time     remaining-life conclusion.
                                of visit.

   Immediate                    Replace the three observed assemblies and reinsulate adjacent          Planning allowance
   recommendation               disturbed pipe.                                                        $145,000; excludes
                                                                                                       concealed conditions,
                                                                                                       abatement, controls
                                                                                                       integration, and downtime.

   Further investigation        Before work, verify pipe wall thickness and insulation condition at    Could change scope; not
                                opened locations.                                                      priced.

   Future recommendation        Consider a system-wide valve modernization plan in the next capital    Not identified as immediate
                                cycle.                                                                 work; no project estimate.

 EXHIBIT D | Northline Roof Consulting Excerpt (Apr. 26, 2026)
 Scope: visual walkover of accessible roof areas; no moisture scan, core cuts, deck testing, or destructive investigation. This is a
 condition opinion, not a roof warranty or bid.

   Finding category             Report wording                                                         Amount / qualification

   Observed condition           Localized seam splits and flashing deterioration were observed in      Conditions may be
                                roughly 12,000 square feet of the north membrane field. No active      weather-dependent.
                                interior leak was observed during the visit.

   Immediate                    Perform localized seam/flashing repairs within 12 months and inspect   Budgetary allowance
   recommendation               after severe weather.                                                  $95,000; excludes wet
                                                                                                       insulation, deck repair,
                                                                                                       mobilization changes, and
                                                                                                       taxes.

   Lifecycle observation        Estimated remaining useful life: 3-5 years; plan for future membrane   Planning range $365,000;
                                replacement.                                                           not a present repair
                                                                                                       directive or bid.




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                           Page 4
  EXHIBIT E | Buyer Correspondence and Call Notes
 May 4, 2026 | Underhill asset manager email: “We are assessing whether the roof and refrigeration items need a credit in the
 purchase price before we can finalize our closing model.”
 May 6, 2026 | Eamon Kristiansen call note: Eamon told Underhill’s deal lead, “we’ll make the report items right.” He recorded that he
 meant the parties would address documented items; no scope, amount, remedy, seller authority, or signed amendment was
 discussed or confirmed.
 May 8, 2026 | Underhill finance email: “Our Indiana financing team needs the consultant files and a clean statement of any seller
 contribution. Please separate roof from refrigeration and show the proposed treatment at closing.” No lender name, lender
 instruction, consultant report, or underwriting condition was attached.
 May 11, 2026 | Underhill deal lead email: “We need a $780,000 credit to stay on the May 29 closing path: $380,000 refrigeration
 reserve, $250,000 roof reserve, and $150,000 purchase-price re-trade.”
 May 12, 2026 | Call note: buyer asked whether “credit” could “show on the closing statement” if its lender required it. Buyer also
 asked for a consultant access window and the roof warranty file. The deal lead said the team needed an answer on Thursday. No
 person said a lender had ordered a credit.

 EXHIBIT E-2 | Demand reconciliation
   Buyer label                                      Requested amount   Character as stated

   Refrigeration reserve                            $380,000           Buyer-requested amount; not an accepted liability.

   Roof reserve                                     $250,000           Buyer-requested amount; not an accepted liability.

   Purchase-price re-trade                          $150,000           Buyer-requested amount; not an accepted liability.

   Aggregate demand                                 $780,000           Buyer describes the aggregate as a “credit.”

 Record observation: the May 4 use of “credit in the purchase price” differs from the May 12 question about a contribution “on the
 closing statement.”




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                       Page 5
  EXHIBIT F | Inglewood Board Authority Record (May 13, 2026)
 Purpose: call authority for May 14. This record supersedes informal broker messaging as an internal authorization record; it does
 not amend the Purchase Agreement.

   Subject                             Authority / limitation

   Maximum aggregate seller            Up to $240,000 total, only for a documented package tied to the reported immediate valve scope and
   exposure                            localized roof repair scope. Seller-paid work, escrow, and any closing credit count toward one cap; no
                                       stacking or double recovery.

   Broker may discuss                  Report files, one escorted consultant-access window, transferable-warranty records, buyer’s
                                       requested mechanics, and a conditional package. Eamon may not bind Seller.

   Required conditions                 Executed annex agreement at or before a material economic concession; signed amendment; Buyer
                                       release of the addressed report items; no warranty or future-performance assurance; unchanged May
                                       29 closing unless Board approves otherwise.

   Approvals                           Reina and Inglewood Board approve economics and annex changes; Jelena Demirci approves credit
                                       terminology, compliance review, and final amendment package; Illinois counsel handles Illinois
                                       real-estate documents and release language; tax adviser / qualified intermediary handles 1031; Buyer
                                       and its lender confirm permitted closing-statement treatment.

   Offer timing                        Any enhanced package may be offered only as a written, all-terms package expiring 5:00 p.m. CT on
                                       Friday, May 15, 2026; if not accepted, the existing agreement remains in force without the enhanced
                                       remedy.

 EXHIBIT G | Compliance Routing Note (May 12, 2026)
 Federal: the May 25 identification date is the seller’s stated federal 1031 timing milestone. Tax adviser and qualified intermediary,
 not the broker, must confirm identification and exchange consequences of any amendment or closing-statement item.
 Illinois: the real estate is in Joliet, Illinois. Illinois counsel should prepare or approve any amendment, annex possession/use
 agreement, property-condition release, and closing documentation affecting the Illinois property.
 Indiana: Underhill’s deal team and financing activity are based in Indiana. That location may explain who requests lender materials
 or a closing-statement format; it does not by itself determine the governing law for the Illinois real estate. Buyer and lender must
 confirm their financing requirements.
 Jelena Demirci: do not use “credit” in a counterproposal unless its mechanism is expressly defined as either a purchase-price
 reduction or a seller contribution shown at closing. Do not use it as a shorthand for both.




Coldharbour transaction record | Confidential working file                                                                                      Page 6

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
CALL AUTHORIZATION | COLDHARBOUR COUNTER-POSITION
To: Eamon Kristiansen, covering broker   |   From: Arjun Fitzgerald   |   Call: Thursday, May 14, 2026, 10:00 a.m. CT
1. Decision to authorize before the call
Authorize one conditional package. Open with clarification and fact testing, not money. “Credit” in this memorandum means only a seller contribution shown on the closing statement; it is not a purchase-price reduction. The existing $18,400,000 contract price stays unchanged. [A; G]
Opening position
Principal boundary
Provide the report files, one escorted consultant-access window, and transferable-warranty records; then consider a tightly documented package only after Underhill states its mechanism and substantiates the driver.
No binding economics. Final-stage aggregate seller exposure may not exceed $240,000 and must be a single closing-statement credit, seller-paid targeted work, or escrow within one cap, never stacked. [B-2; F]

Buyer has asked for $780,000: $380,000 refrigeration reserve + $250,000 roof reserve + $150,000 purchase-price re-trade. Attribute this to Underhill; do not call it a liability. [E-2]
Non-negotiable reciprocal term: execute the 60-day east loading annex (approximately 8,000 square feet) use agreement (May 30, 2026–July 28, 2026) before or simultaneously with any material economic concession. It is the reason not to spend economic leverage first. [B; F]
2. Read this opening, then ask only these questions
Opening language: “We have received the $780,000 request and the report materials. Before we discuss economics, I need to separate the requested remedy, the documented scope, and the closing mechanics so we can put forward one workable written package. We are prepared to address documented items in an authorized agreement, not make an open-ended commitment.”
Ask
Why it changes the branch
“When you say credit, do you mean a price reduction, a seller contribution shown on the closing statement, seller-paid work, or another mechanism?”
Pins down mechanics before value moves. [E; G]
“Is a lender, lender consultant, or underwriting condition driving any item? Please identify it and send the directive, consultant requirement, or closing-statement instruction.”
Tests the lender hypothesis without alleging it. [E]
“Which observed condition and which report recommendation supports each component, and who has authority to accept a documented package?”
Separates scope and decision-maker. [C; D; E]
“What needs to be signed, and by when, to preserve the May 29 closing?”
Tests timing against the signed-document requirement. [A; E]

Inference, not fact: the May 8 request for a “clean statement” from Underhill’s Indiana financing team, the May 12 question about a closing-statement item, and the request for consultant files may be consistent with lender re-underwriting. No lender instruction or condition has been provided. [E]
3. Ordered concession sequence | value only releases through the gate
Stage
What Eamon may give or say
Must obtain in return / stop
1. Clarify
Acknowledge the demand; provide existing Polar/Northline files, warranty records, and offer the one escorted access window. [B-2; F]
Obtain the mechanism, item-by-item support, decision-maker, timing, and lender evidence. STOP: no commitment while any of these is unresolved.
2. Package the non-price response
Offer a written conditional amendment concept: consultant access, transferable-warranty records without warranty of transferability, and a choice of targeted cure or escrow limited to the two immediate report scopes. [B-2; C; D; F]
Underhill must execute the annex agreement, confirm May 29 closing, release the addressed report items, and accept no future-performance warranty. Do not release items independently.
3. Final authorized economics
Only if Underhill supplies lender-driven documentation and accepts the full package, say a seller contribution shown on the closing statement may be considered up to the single $240,000 cap, subject to Reina/Board approval, Jelena’s review, lender acceptance, and signed documents. [F]
Annex and amendment signed at or before the economic concession; one exclusive remedy, offset against seller-paid work or escrow, release, no price reduction, and May 29 closing retained. Offer expires 5:00 p.m. CT on Friday, May 15, 2026. [A; F]

Cap calculation: buyer request $780,000; Board authority $240,000; current report planning allowances $145,000 + $95,000 = $240,000. The lowest applicable limit is $240,000. The Polar and Northline figures are allowances, not bids or accepted liability. [C; D; F]
4. Conditional call branches
If Underhill...
Eamon’s authorized response
substantiates a lender-driven requirement
“Send the identified condition and mechanics. Subject to review, we can circulate the documented package described above. The annex agreement, release, closing schedule, and exclusive-remedy treatment travel with it.” Do not name a dollar amount before approvals.
cannot substantiate a lender driver
“We can make the records and access available, and we can evaluate a targeted, documented response in the written package. We are not revising price or agreeing to a cash contribution on this call.” Keep value at Stages 1-2.
insists on the full $780,000 now
“I do not have authority to agree to $780,000 or to a price reduction or closing credit on this call. Please provide the item support and lender basis; I will take a complete package for review.” Pause and escalate to Arjun, Reina/Board, and Jelena. [E-2; F]
uses schedule or seller timing to demand an immediate answer
“We are working to the May 29 schedule, but any change requires a reviewed written package. We can turn the requested materials and a package discussion promptly; I cannot improvise an amendment.” Do not mention Reina’s 1031 pressure. [A; F]

5. Guardrails and controlled clarification
Never give
Reason / source
Never give an unconditional purchase-price reduction or closing credit before the annex right and all package conditions are secured.
The agreement price remains unchanged unless amended; annex is the owner priority. [A; B; F]
Never give an uncapped or open-ended obligation to repair report items.
Reports contain exclusions, further investigation, future work, and planning allowances. [C; D; F]
Never give broad assurances about the roof, refrigeration system, or future performance.
Neither report is a warranty; the agreement limits survival absent writing. [A; C; D]
Never sacrifice or defer the 60-day annex right in exchange for keeping the sale alive.
Owner instruction makes it essential. [B]
Never waive the signed-amendment, release, May 29 closing, or closing-document safeguards.
They are express Board conditions. [A; F]

Truthful clarification of Eamon’s earlier statement: “I did say we would make the report items right. I am not withdrawing that; I am clarifying that the seller will address documented, authorized items through a written agreement. We did not settle scope, amount, remedy, or a warranty in that conversation.” The May 6 statement is acknowledged, but it is not a settled scope, dollar commitment, admission, or warranty. [E; F]
6. Report discipline, roles, and timing
Record item
Call treatment
Refrigeration: observed corrosion/seepage at three valve assemblies; immediate replacement allowance $145,000. Further wall-thickness/insulation verification is unpriced; system-wide modernization is future work. [C]
Only the three-assembly immediate recommendation is within the authority reference point. Do not absorb concealed conditions, abatement, controls, downtime, or future modernization.
Roof: localized seam/flashing deterioration; immediate repair allowance $95,000. Remaining life 3-5 years; future replacement planning range $365,000. [D]
Only localized repair is the authority reference point. Do not convert the lifecycle range, possible wet insulation, deck conditions, or weather-dependent observations into a present obligation.

Roles: Eamon may conduct Stages 1-2 and repeat the conditional framework; he may not bind Seller. Arjun coordinates the counterproposal. Reina and Inglewood Board approve economics/annex change. Jelena approves terminology and compliance package. Illinois counsel reviews Illinois property documents, annex and release. Tax adviser/qualified intermediary confirms the federal 1031 identification issue by May 25, 2026; Buyer/lender confirms financing and closing-statement treatment. [F; G]
Timetable: May 14 call -> obtain evidence and authority path -> circulate only a reviewed written package -> acceptance/reversion at 5:00 p.m. CT on Friday, May 15, 2026 -> preserve scheduled May 29, 2026 closing -> annex use May 30, 2026–July 28, 2026. The May 25 1031 date is a federal timing milestone, not an Illinois or Indiana rule. Illinois matters follow the property situs; Indiana is relevant only to Underhill’s team/financing, not as presumed governing law. Counsel, tax professionals, and lender must confirm their respective consequences. [A; B; F; G]
7. Operative authorized call position
Execute this position: no economic concession on the call. First clarify “credit,” obtain item support and lender documentation, and offer source-supported records/access. Only a complete written package, with the executed 60-day annex right, May 29 closing, release, no warranty, no stacking, and required approvals, may reach a final-stage seller contribution shown on the closing statement up to $240,000. Otherwise, stop, preserve the existing agreement, and escalate. [A; B; F]

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于确切的顶级文件名中，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认`coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx`存在于顶层并且无需修复即可打开。

original.criterion: The required DOCX is present at the exact top-level filename and opens as a valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted working directory and DOCX package.
original.grader_hint: Confirm `coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx` exists at the top level and can be opened without repair.

criteria.description: 渲染的文档不包含任何被剪裁、丢失、损坏或不可读的实质性内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染所有页面并检查表格、页眉、页脚、符号和分页符是否有内容丢失。

original.criterion: The rendered document contains no clipped, missing, corrupted, or unreadable substantive content.
original.grader_hint: Render all pages and inspect tables, headers, footers, symbols, and page breaks for loss of content.

criteria.description: 完整的备忘录，包括表格和附录，不超过六页。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算每个渲染的页面；隐藏或附录材料计入上限。

original.criterion: The complete memorandum, including tables and appendices, is no more than six rendered pages.
original.grader_hint: Count every rendered page; hidden or appendix material counts toward the cap.

criteria.description: 该文件的作用是授权和调用使用备忘录，而不是通用的财产摘要或检查回顾。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者应立即了解授权的决定、谈判目的以及如何在电话会议中使用备忘录。

original.criterion: The document functions as an authorization and call-use memorandum rather than as a generic property summary or inspection recap.
original.grader_hint: A reader should immediately understand the decision being authorized, the negotiation purpose, and how the memo will be used on the call.

criteria.description: 重要的货币数字、日期、引用的陈述、财产条款和报告断言都可以追溯到证据包中的可识别位置。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录参考与提供的 PDF 进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受简洁的页面、插图、消息日期、报告部分或类似的明确引用；验证每个事实类型的代表性样本。

original.criterion: Material monetary figures, dates, quoted statements, property terms, and report assertions are traceable to identifiable locations in the evidence bundle.
original.evidence: Memo references compared with the supplied PDF.
original.grader_hint: Accept concise page, exhibit, message-date, report-section, or similarly unambiguous references; verify a representative sample across each fact type.

criteria.description: 备忘录正确地关联了星期四的电话会议、结束时间表和规定的1031识别截止日期，而没有改变它们的顺序或间隔。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录和证据包中的时间线事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所有规定的日期和间隔与捆绑包进行比较，并确认备忘录保留了 11 天的紧迫性。

original.criterion: The memorandum correctly relates the Thursday call, the closing schedule, and the stated 1031 identification deadline without changing their order or interval.
original.evidence: Timeline facts in the memorandum and evidence bundle.
original.grader_hint: Compare all stated dates and intervals with the bundle and confirm that the memo preserves the eleven-day urgency.

criteria.description: 该备忘录提出了一种连贯的反对立场，而不是提出多种未排序的替代方案供业主自行设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 拟议的一揽子计划可能包含阶段和有条件的分支，但它必须代表一个综合的谈判立场。

original.criterion: The memorandum advances one coherent counter-position rather than presenting multiple unranked alternatives for the owner to design herself.
original.grader_hint: The proposed package may contain stages and conditional branches, but it must represent one integrated negotiating position.

criteria.description: 在进行支撑分析之前可以快速找到授权的开放位置和主要经济边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 通话参与者不需要阅读整个文件来识别仓位和最大授权风险。

original.criterion: The authorized opening position and principal economic boundary can be found quickly before the supporting analysis.
original.grader_hint: A call participant should not need to read the entire file to identify the position and the maximum authorized exposure.

criteria.description: 在使用“信用”一词作为反立场的一部分之前，备忘录明确定义了“信用”的含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与拟议交易机制相关的有效定义，而不仅仅是来源不明确的声明。

original.criterion: The memorandum expressly defines what it means by “credit” before using that term as part of the counter-position.
original.grader_hint: Look for an operative definition tied to the proposed deal mechanics, not merely a statement that the source is ambiguous.

criteria.description: 所选择的“信用”含义在推荐、顺序、调用语言和授权限制中一致使用。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查购买价格降低和结算信用在定义后不会默默地互换。

original.criterion: The chosen meaning of “credit” is used consistently in the recommendation, sequence, call language, and authorization limits.
original.grader_hint: Check that purchase-price reduction and closing credit are not silently interchanged after the definition.

criteria.description: 该备忘录区分了购买价格变化、结算信用、卖方付费工作、托管和非现金经营特许权，这些替代方案会产生不同的后果。
criteria.evidence: 经济分析和建议的顺序。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果备忘录认识到相同的名义金额可能在资金、文件、贷方、税收或杠杆效应方面有所不同，但没有给出不受支持的法律结论，则为信用。

original.criterion: The memorandum distinguishes purchase-price changes, closing credits, seller-paid work, escrows, and non-cash operating concessions where those alternatives have different consequences.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the memo recognizes that equal nominal amounts can differ in funding, documentation, lender, tax, or leverage effects without giving unsupported legal conclusions.

criteria.description: 买方的总再交易需求表示为$780,000，容差为±$0。
criteria.evidence: 证据包中的备忘录和买方需求。
criteria.grader_hint: 该数字必须准确且明确地归因于买方的需求，而不是归因于已接受的责任。

original.criterion: The buyer’s aggregate re-trade demand is stated as $780,000 with a tolerance of ±$0.
original.evidence: Memorandum and buyer demand in the evidence bundle.
original.grader_hint: The figure must be exact and clearly attributed to the buyer’s demand rather than to an accepted liability.

criteria.description: $780,000 需求的任何细目都与买方自己的组件金额一致，并且总和返回到规定的总额。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录计算和买家通信。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算任何显示的组件；如果备忘录没有使用细分，则不需要细分，但只有在组件级别准确分析需求的情况下才授予奖励。

original.criterion: Any breakdown of the $780,000 demand agrees with the buyer’s own component amounts and sums back to the stated total.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate any displayed components; do not require a breakdown if the memo does not use one, but award only if the demand is analyzed at component level accurately.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将观察到的缺陷、建议的未来工作、预算津贴和买方要求的金额分开，而不是将它们视为同等的负债。
criteria.evidence: 检查分析与报告语言的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查制冷和屋顶讨论的类别规则。

original.criterion: The memorandum separates observed defects, recommended future work, budgetary allowances, and buyer-requested amounts rather than treating them as equivalent liabilities.
original.evidence: Inspection analysis compared with report language.
original.grader_hint: Check both the refrigeration and roof discussion for category discipline.

criteria.description: 保留影响谈判价值的重大报告资格、范围限制和时间区别。
criteria.evidence: 检查报告摘录和备忘录。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不应将初步、预算、生命周期或进一步调查的语言转换为当前经过验证的成本。

original.criterion: Material report qualifications, scope limitations, and timing distinctions that affect negotiation value are preserved.
original.grader_hint: The memo should not convert preliminary, budgetary, lifecycle, or further-investigation language into a present verified cost.

criteria.description: 买方请求的模式被分析为可能与贷方再承保一致。
criteria.evidence: 买家信函、电话记录和备忘录分析。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找时间、措辞、文件要求和融资参考的综合，而不是纯粹的断言。

original.criterion: The pattern of the buyer’s requests is analyzed as potentially consistent with lender re-underwriting.
original.evidence: Buyer correspondence, call notes, and memorandum analysis.
original.grader_hint: Look for synthesis of timing, wording, documentation requests, and financing references rather than a bare assertion.

criteria.description: 贷方重新承保被标记为推论或假设，而不是作为已确认的事实表示。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果备忘录声明或暗示贷款人在捆绑包未确认时明确下令重新交易，则失败。

original.criterion: Lender re-underwriting is labeled as an inference or hypothesis, not represented as a confirmed fact.
original.grader_hint: Fail if the memo states or implies that the lender definitely ordered the re-trade when the bundle does not confirm it.

criteria.description: 拟议的赎回计划通过在改变经济状况之前要求相关确认或文件来测试贷方假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 所要求的证据应足够具体，以区分贷款人的条件与买方的谈判偏好。

original.criterion: The proposed call plan tests the lender hypothesis by requesting the relevant confirmation or documentation before changing economics.
original.grader_hint: The requested proof should be specific enough to distinguish a lender condition from the buyer’s negotiating preference.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认1031截止日期会造成卖方时机风险，但并未将其视为立即放弃杠杆的理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用平衡处理期限风险和杠杆保留。

original.criterion: The memorandum recognizes that the 1031 deadline creates seller timing risk without treating it as a reason to surrender leverage immediately.
original.grader_hint: Credit balanced treatment of deadline exposure and leverage preservation.

criteria.description: 通话指导避免不必要地将卖方的1031压力宣传为谈判漏洞。
criteria.grader_hint: 内部确认是适当的；外部脚本不应自愿绝望或暗示将接受任何要求以保留交换。

original.criterion: The call guidance avoids unnecessarily advertising the seller’s 1031 pressure as a negotiating vulnerability.
original.grader_hint: Internal acknowledgment is appropriate; external scripts should not volunteer desperation or imply that any demand will be accepted to preserve the exchange.

criteria.description: 60日装载附件回租或使用权被视为卖方的基本目标，与业主优先权证据一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 它应该是套餐的受保护条款，而不是推迟到价格让步后的小项目。

original.criterion: The 60-day loading-annex leaseback or use right is treated as an essential seller objective, consistent with the owner-priority evidence.
original.grader_hint: It should be a protected term of the package, not a minor item deferred until after price is conceded.

criteria.description: 拟议的附件安排包括证据包中提供的使60日使用权可执行所需的每个重要条款。
criteria.evidence: 拟议的回租条款和来源交易说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较捆绑包的持续时间、覆盖面积、访问权限、运营责任、成本、保险或风险分配以及周转条款；不要要求来源中没有的条款。

original.criterion: The proposed annex arrangement includes every material term supplied in the evidence bundle that is necessary to make the 60-day use right executable.
original.evidence: Proposed leaseback terms and source transaction notes.
original.grader_hint: Compare duration, covered area, access, operating responsibility, cost, insurance or risk allocation, and turnover terms to the bundle; do not demand terms absent from the source.

criteria.description: 备忘录解释说，经济让步是确保附件权可用的杠杆，因此不应首先使用。
criteria.grader_hint: 顺序与卖方优先权的保留之间的因果关系必须是明确的。

original.criterion: The memorandum explains that an economic concession is the leverage available to secure the annex right and therefore should not be spent first.
original.grader_hint: The causal link between sequence and preservation of the seller’s priority must be explicit.

criteria.description: 备忘录中准确披露了卖方之前的声明，即卖方将“纠正报告项目”。
criteria.evidence: 通过电子邮件或电话发送备注和备忘录。
criteria.grader_hint: 应出现准确的引用或忠实引用的片段，以便合规审核员可以看到正在管理的问题。

original.criterion: The prior statement that the seller would “make the report items right” is disclosed accurately in the memorandum.
original.evidence: Email or call note and memorandum.
original.grader_hint: The exact quotation or a faithful quoted fragment should appear so the compliance reviewer can see the issue being managed.

criteria.description: 备忘录并不将非正式声明视为确定的范围、授权的资金承诺、保证或承认责任。
criteria.grader_hint: 在承认沟通和将其扩展到证据之外之间寻找专业上可以辩护的区别。

original.criterion: The memorandum does not treat the informal statement as a settled scope, authorized dollar commitment, warranty, or admission of liability.
original.grader_hint: Look for a professionally defensible distinction between acknowledging the communication and expanding it beyond the evidence.

criteria.description: 通话指南提供了一种真实的方式来澄清先前的承诺，而不否认该承诺的存在或指责买方误解了该承诺。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞应将承诺范围缩小到记录在案的、授权的条款，同时保持可信度。

original.criterion: The call guidance supplies a truthful way to clarify the prior promise without denying that it was made or accusing the buyer of misunderstanding it.
original.grader_hint: The wording should narrow the commitment to documented, authorized terms while preserving credibility.

criteria.description: 让步顺序从澄清和事实检验开始，而不是从金钱报价开始。
criteria.grader_hint: 第一阶段应在价值转移之前解决需求的含义和驱动因素。

original.criterion: The concession sequence begins with clarification and fact testing rather than with a monetary offer.
original.grader_hint: The first stage should resolve the meaning and driver of the demand before value is transferred.

criteria.description: 这一顺序阻止了埃蒙做出具有约束力的让步，而“信用”的含义、贷款人的角色或所主张的范围仍然没有得到解决。
criteria.evidence: 呼叫当局并发出停止指令。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的控制点，而不仅仅是建议谨慎行事。

original.criterion: The sequence prevents Eamon from making a binding concession while the meaning of “credit,” the lender role, or the claimed scope remains unresolved.
original.grader_hint: Look for a clear hold point rather than merely advising caution.

criteria.description: 记录支持的较低成本或非价格反应优先于广泛的现金或价格让步。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例可能包括访问、文档、可转让权利、针对性治疗、托管结构或仅在捆绑包支持的情况下的时间条款。

original.criterion: Lower-cost or non-price responses supported by the record are positioned before a broad cash or price concession.
original.grader_hint: Examples may include access, documentation, assignable rights, targeted cure, escrow structure, or timing terms only where supported by the bundle.

criteria.description: 任何提供的屋顶或制冷响应仅限于源支持的范围，并且不吸收不相关的、未来的、可选的或生命周期的工作。
criteria.evidence: 提供的范围与检查材料相比。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪每个提供的项目以找到适用的报告结果和资格。

original.criterion: Any offered roof or refrigeration response is limited to source-supported scope and does not absorb unrelated, future, optional, or lifecycle work.
original.evidence: Offered scope compared with inspection materials.
original.grader_hint: Trace each offered item to the applicable report finding and qualification.

criteria.description: 需要在任何重大经济让步之前或同时执行60天的附件安排。
criteria.grader_hint: 承诺稍后谈判附件是不够的。

original.criterion: Execution of the 60-day annex arrangement is required before or simultaneously with any material economic concession.
original.grader_hint: A promise to negotiate the annex later is not sufficient.

criteria.description: 优惠是作为有条件的一揽子计划而不是作为独立的礼物提供的，买方可以在拒绝卖方的互惠条款的同时保留这种礼物。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的 if/then、包、同步文档或条件接受机制。

original.criterion: Concessions are presented as a conditional package rather than as independent gifts that the buyer may retain while rejecting the seller’s reciprocal terms.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit if/then, package, simultaneous-document, or contingent-acceptance mechanics.

criteria.description: 该序列逐步释放价值，除非满足早期阶段的条件，否则后续阶段不可用。
criteria.grader_hint: 阶段应该像真正的大门一样运作，而不仅仅是一次性提供的所有优惠的编号列表。

original.criterion: The sequence releases value incrementally, with later stages unavailable unless the conditions for earlier stages are satisfied.
original.grader_hint: Stages should operate as real gates, not merely as a numbered list of offers all available at once.

criteria.description: 每项材料卖方让步都表明了相应的买方承诺或风险降低。
criteria.grader_hint: 互惠可能包括回租执行、范围释放、成交确定性、贷方确认、进度保护或其他来源支持的回报。

original.criterion: Each material seller concession identifies a corresponding buyer commitment or risk reduction.
original.grader_hint: Reciprocity may include leaseback execution, scope release, closing certainty, lender confirmation, schedule protection, or another source-supported return.

criteria.description: 任何金钱上的让步都是为最终授权阶段保留的，而不是锚定开场反应。
criteria.grader_hint: 该序列可能会在内部讨论上限，但最初的外部举措不应简单地承认价格或现金。

original.criterion: Any monetary concession is reserved for the final authorized stage rather than anchoring the opening response.
original.grader_hint: The sequence may discuss a ceiling internally, but the initial external move should not simply concede price or cash.

criteria.description: 建议的最大卖方风险不超过权威机构、验证范围和买方需求之间的最低适用来源支持限制。
criteria.evidence: 授权证据、检查支持、买家需求和备忘录计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用捆绑包中的控制限制重新计算上限，并确认现金、托管和卖方付费工作的处理方式一致。

original.criterion: The maximum proposed seller exposure does not exceed the lowest applicable source-supported limit among authority, verified scope, and the buyer’s demand.
original.evidence: Authorization evidence, inspection support, buyer demand, and memo calculations.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the cap using the controlling limits in the bundle and confirm consistent treatment of cash, escrow, and seller-paid work.

criteria.description: 该套餐可防止针对相同情况的信用、维修付款、托管、保修转让或其他补救措施的叠加或双重恢复。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找适合经纪人级别推荐的抵消、选择、排他性补救措施或等效的反重复语言。

original.criterion: The package prevents stacking or double recovery across a credit, repair payment, escrow, warranty assignment, or other remedy for the same condition.
original.grader_hint: Look for offset, election, exclusive-remedy, or equivalent anti-duplication language suitable for broker-level recommendation.

criteria.description: 该要约具有与源一致的接受截止日期或恢复机制，可以在包不被接受时保护现有交易。
criteria.evidence: 拟议的时间安排和现有协议条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不应无限期地保留增强的特许权，或暗示放弃原始合同而不接受。

original.criterion: The offer has a source-consistent acceptance deadline or reversion mechanism that protects the existing deal if the package is not accepted.
original.evidence: Proposed timing and existing agreement terms.
original.grader_hint: The memo should not leave an enhanced concession open indefinitely or imply that the original contract is waived without acceptance.

criteria.description: “绝不给予”指导方针禁止在附件权和一揽子条件得到保障之前无条件降低购买价格或关闭信贷。
criteria.grader_hint: 该禁令必须足够明确，以便承保经纪商在通话期间适用。

original.criterion: The “never give” guidance prohibits an unconditional purchase-price reduction or closing credit before the annex right and package conditions are secured.
original.grader_hint: The prohibition must be explicit enough for the covering broker to apply during the call.

criteria.description: “绝不给予”指导禁止无上限或无限制的修复报告项目的义务。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受要求定义范围和规定上限的措辞，否则禁止无限暴露。

original.criterion: The “never give” guidance prohibits an uncapped or open-ended obligation to repair report items.
original.grader_hint: Accept wording that requires defined scope and a stated cap or otherwise bars unlimited exposure.

criteria.description: “绝不给予”指导方针禁止对屋顶、制冷系统或未来性能提供超出所提供证据的新的广泛保证。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找防止创建新条件保修或保证使用寿命的保护措施。

original.criterion: The “never give” guidance prohibits new broad assurances about the roof, refrigeration system, or future performance beyond the supplied evidence.
original.grader_hint: Look for protection against creating a new condition warranty or guaranteeing useful life.

criteria.description: “绝不给予”指导保护了合同、成交、放行和文件保障措施，证据显示这些保障措施对卖方仍然重要。
criteria.evidence: 现有的交易条款和备忘录护栏。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅归功于捆绑中的保障措施；备忘录无需复制协议。

original.criterion: The “never give” guidance protects contract, closing, release, and documentation safeguards that the evidence shows remain material to the seller.
original.evidence: Existing transaction terms and memo guardrails.
original.grader_hint: Credit only for safeguards grounded in the bundle; the memo need not reproduce the agreement.

criteria.description: “绝不给予”指导明确禁止牺牲或推迟 60 天附件权来换取保持销售活力。
criteria.evidence: 所有者优先事项和备忘录护栏。
criteria.grader_hint: 该指令必须解决这种权衡，而不仅仅是强调附件重要。

original.criterion: The “never give” guidance expressly bars sacrificing or deferring the 60-day annex right in exchange for keeping the sale alive.
original.grader_hint: The instruction must resolve this tradeoff rather than merely call the annex important.

criteria.description: 备忘录为埃蒙提供了可用的开场白，承认需求但不接受其前提或金额。
criteria.grader_hint: 该语言应该足够接近口语措辞，以便代理经纪人可以直接使用它。

original.criterion: The memorandum gives Eamon usable opening language that acknowledges the demand without accepting its premise or amount.
original.grader_hint: The language should be close enough to spoken wording that a covering broker can use it directly.

criteria.description: 通话计划包含一组紧凑的有目的的问题，可以确定范围、决策者、融资驱动因素和所需的时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 询问应获取变更授权分支机构的信息；一般性的关系问题不算在内。

original.criterion: The call plan contains a compact set of purposeful questions that can determine scope, decision-maker, financing driver, and required timing.
original.grader_hint: Questions should obtain information that changes the authorized branch; generic rapport questions do not count.

criteria.description: 至少提出一个问题，直接确定贷款人、贷款人顾问或承保条件是否推动了请求以及支持该请求的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 这个问题应该寻求可验证的细节，而不是指责买方利用贷款人作为借口。

original.criterion: At least one proposed question directly identifies whether a lender, lender consultant, or underwriting condition is driving the request and what evidence supports it.
original.grader_hint: The question should seek verifiable detail rather than accuse the buyer of using the lender as a pretext.

criteria.description: 至少有一个提出的问题要求买方说明“信用”是否意味着降价、结算信用、卖方付费工作或其他机制。
criteria.grader_hint: 在谈判进行之前，这个问题必须确定机制。

original.criterion: At least one proposed question requires the buyer to state whether “credit” means a price reduction, a closing credit, seller-paid work, or another mechanism.
original.grader_hint: The question must pin down mechanics before negotiation proceeds.

criteria.description: 如果买方证实了贷方驱动的要求，则备忘录提供可执行的响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 分支机构应确定下一个允许的报价、所需的互惠和停止点。

original.criterion: The memorandum supplies an executable response if the buyer substantiates a lender-driven requirement.
original.grader_hint: The branch should identify the next permitted offer, required reciprocity, and stopping point.

criteria.description: 如果买方无法证实贷方驱动的要求，则备忘录提供不同的可执行响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 证据较弱的分支机构应该保留更多的卖方价值，而不是默认同样的让步。

original.criterion: The memorandum supplies a different executable response if the buyer cannot substantiate a lender-driven requirement.
original.grader_hint: The weaker-evidence branch should preserve more seller value and not default to the same concession.

criteria.description: 备忘录告诉埃蒙，如果昂德希尔坚持立即获得完整的$780,000，该如何应对。
criteria.evidence: 呼叫分支机构和权限限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 回应应说明他可能会说什么、他可能不会同意什么，以及他是否会暂停或升级。

original.criterion: The memorandum tells Eamon how to respond if Underhill insists on the full $780,000 immediately.
original.grader_hint: The response should state what he may say, what he may not agree to, and whether he pauses or escalates.

criteria.description: 备忘录告诉埃蒙，如果昂德希尔利用交割时间表或卖方的时间压力要求立即答复，该如何应对。
criteria.grader_hint: 分支机构应保留最后期限，而无需授权临时让步。

original.criterion: The memorandum tells Eamon how to respond if Underhill uses the closing schedule or the seller’s timing pressure to demand an immediate answer.
original.grader_hint: The branch should preserve the deadline without authorizing an improvised concession.

criteria.description: 谈判、批准、合规审查、起草和专家建议职责的分配与证据包中显示的角色和权限一致。
criteria.evidence: 职责分配和来源权限记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认没有任何参与者被授予捆绑包保留的权限，并且基本操作有指定的所有者。

original.criterion: Negotiation, approval, compliance review, drafting, and specialist-advice responsibilities are assigned consistently with the roles and authority shown in the evidence bundle.
original.evidence: Responsibility assignments and source authority records.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that no participant is given authority the bundle withholds and that essential actions have a named owner.

criteria.description: 运营时间表从周四的电话会议和相关交易截止日期开始向后推算，所有拟议的里程碑均按可行的顺序进行。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录时间表和证据包日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查批准、调用、文件、任何接受期、结束、附件使用和1031里程碑的顺序。

original.criterion: The operational timetable works backward from the Thursday call and relevant transaction deadlines, with all proposed milestones occurring in a feasible order.
original.grader_hint: Check sequencing of approval, call, documentation, any acceptance period, closing, annex use, and 1031 milestones.

criteria.description: 备忘录规定了埃蒙可以在电话会议上解决哪些问题，以及哪些问题需要所有者、合规部、律师、税务、贷款人或其他专家的确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 指示应该足够具体，以防止未经授权的协议，同时避免整个谈判的全面转交。

original.criterion: The memorandum states which matters Eamon may resolve on the call and which require owner, compliance, counsel, tax, lender, or other specialist confirmation.
original.grader_hint: Instructions should be concrete enough to prevent unauthorized agreement while avoiding blanket referral of the whole negotiation.

criteria.description: 管辖权讨论将联邦1031时间与州特定经纪、财产、文件或成交考虑因素区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 管辖权讨论和来源合规材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不应将联邦身份识别截止日期描述为伊利诺伊州或印第安纳州的规定。

original.criterion: The jurisdiction discussion distinguishes federal 1031 timing from state-specific brokerage, property, documentation, or closing considerations.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction discussion and source compliance material.
original.grader_hint: The memo should not describe the federal identification deadline as an Illinois or Indiana rule.

criteria.description: 伊利诺伊州的讨论正确地将财产的位置和伊利诺伊州特定的源材料与拟议的交易处理联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查备忘录是否确定了捆绑包支持的伊利诺伊州实际含义，而不仅仅是命名该州。

original.criterion: The Illinois discussion correctly connects the property’s location and the Illinois-specific source material to the proposed transaction handling.
original.grader_hint: Check that the memo identifies the practical Illinois implication supported by the bundle rather than merely naming the state.

criteria.description: 印第安纳州的讨论正确地限制了买方总部、融资活动或印第安纳州参与者与证据支持的影响的相关性。
criteria.grader_hint: 该备忘录应解释与印第安纳州的相关联系，而不假设印第安纳州法律管辖伊利诺伊州房地产。

original.criterion: The Indiana discussion correctly limits the relevance of the buyer’s headquarters, financing activity, or Indiana-based participants to the implications supported by the evidence.
original.grader_hint: The memo should explain the relevant Indiana connection without assuming Indiana law governs the Illinois real estate.

criteria.description: 该备忘录没有陈述明确的法律或税务结论，并指出了需要合格律师或税务顾问确认的具体要点。
criteria.evidence: 管辖权、1031 和文档语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果其他地方的实质性文本提供了明确的法律或税务建议，则仅通用免责声明是不够的。

original.criterion: The memorandum does not state definitive legal or tax conclusions and identifies the specific points that need confirmation by qualified counsel or tax advisers.
original.grader_hint: A generic disclaimer alone is insufficient if substantive text elsewhere gives categorical legal or tax advice.

criteria.description: 该备忘录对交易的重大风险进行了优先排序，并将每个优先风险与建议序列中嵌入的缓解措施联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 预期风险包括杠杆损失、附件访问、不受支持的范围、权限、时间表和文档；信用综合而不是一个不连贯的风险清单。

original.criterion: The memorandum prioritizes the transaction’s material risks and links each priority risk to a mitigation embedded in the recommended sequence.
original.grader_hint: Expected risks include leverage loss, annex access, unsupported scope, authority, schedule, and documentation; credit synthesis rather than a disconnected risk list.

criteria.description: 备忘录将授权的谈判立场记录为较早前非正式沟通的受控变更，并确定了哪些先前的谅解正在被澄清或取代。
criteria.evidence: 授权语言和对事先承诺的处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 该工件应该创建可审查的决策记录，而不仅仅是提供私人建议。

original.criterion: The memorandum records the authorized negotiating position as a controlled change from the earlier informal communication and identifies what prior understanding is being clarified or superseded.
original.evidence: Authorization language and treatment of the prior promise.
original.grader_hint: The artifact should create a reviewable decision record, not merely offer private advice.

criteria.description: 不熟悉交易的经纪人可以在通话期间使用备忘录，而无需要求作者提供缺失的订单、措辞、权限、分支或停止条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断通话压力下的实际可用性；简洁的表格、脚本和视觉层次结构可能会有所帮助，但不需要特定的布局。

original.criterion: A broker unfamiliar with the transaction can use the memorandum during the call without asking the author to supply missing order, wording, authority, branches, or stop conditions.
original.grader_hint: Judge practical usability under call pressure; concise tables, scripts, and visual hierarchy may help, but no specific layout is required.

criteria.description: 该文件专业简洁、直观易懂，并且在术语、数字、日期、建议和权限限制方面内部一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查摘要、分析、顺序、脚本和护栏之间是否存在矛盾，以及六页产品是否仍然可用。

original.criterion: The document is professionally concise, visually navigable, and internally consistent in terminology, figures, dates, recommendation, and authority limits.
original.grader_hint: Check for contradictions between summary, analysis, sequence, scripts, and guardrails, as well as whether the six-page product remains usable.

criteria.description: 备忘录以有效的授权呼叫立场或决策边界结束，而不是未解决的替代方案列表或通用的后续步骤结论。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录的最后实质性部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 最后的要点应该强化埃蒙要执行的立场。

original.criterion: The memorandum ends with the operative authorized call position or decision boundary rather than an unresolved list of alternatives or a generic next-steps conclusion.
original.evidence: Final substantive portion of the memorandum.
original.grader_hint: The final takeaway should reinforce the one position Eamon is to execute.

criteria.description: 备忘录发明了任何不受支持的金额、估价、维修估算、截止日期、财产事实、法律要求、税务结果或交易条款。
criteria.evidence: 整个备忘录与完整的证据包进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果创建了任何重要的事实或数字术语而不是追踪其来源，则应用一次。不要仅仅因为备忘录提出了明确的谈判推论或专业建议而申请。

original.criterion: The memorandum invents any unsupported dollar amount, valuation, repair estimate, deadline, property fact, legal requirement, tax result, or deal term.
original.evidence: Entire memorandum compared with the complete evidence bundle.
original.grader_hint: Apply once if any material factual or numerical term is created rather than traced to the source. Do not apply merely because the memo makes a clearly labeled negotiation inference or professional recommendation.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

spec.professional_context: A commercial real estate broker must convert a complete but mixed transaction record into an executable negotiating position under deadline pressure. The memorandum will be used by a covering broker on the buyer call and reviewed by the seller’s compliance function.
difficulty_sources: Sequencing individually defensible concessions so the seller does not surrender the only leverage available for the essential post-closing annex right.
Converting mixed reports, correspondence, authority records, and deadlines into one internally consistent and executable call position.
Handling an ambiguous deal term and a prior informal promise without making unsupported legal, technical, lender, or tax assertions.
Separating report-supported facts from a defensible but unconfirmed inference of lender re-underwriting.
Applying Illinois, Indiana, and federal considerations only to the parts of the transaction they actually govern.

reference_artifact.format: A single searchable PDF evidence bundle assembled from mixed workplace records.
content_requirements: Include an executed agreement abstract or transaction summary showing price, closing schedule, current amendment status, inspection-related rights, amendment mechanics, and any relevant survival or release provisions.

Include an owner-priority record establishing that uninterrupted use of a specified loading annex for 60 days after closing is operationally essential and more important than preserving every dollar of headline price.

Include roof and refrigeration report excerpts that distinguish observed conditions, immediate recommended work, future or lifecycle recommendations, budgetary estimates, exclusions, and requests for further investigation.
Include the buyer’s $780,000 re-trade and enough component detail for the components to reconcile exactly to the aggregate request.
Include correspondence that uses “credit” in at least two materially different senses: purchase-price reduction and a seller credit shown at closing.
Include the broker’s informal statement that the seller will make the report items right, together with surrounding context showing that no scope, amount, remedy, or authority was fixed.
Include buyer communications and call notes whose timing and wording support, but do not prove, an inference of lender re-underwriting.

Include a current authority record identifying the seller’s maximum authorized economic exposure, matters the covering broker may discuss, and matters requiring owner, compliance, counsel, tax, or other specialist approval.

Include source-supported non-price or lower-cost responses, such as targeted cure choices, access, documentation, assignable warranties, escrow mechanics, or timing accommodations, without labeling a preferred sequence.

Include all material terms needed to make the 60-day annex arrangement executable, including the applicable space, dates, access, operating responsibilities, cost treatment, insurance or risk allocation, and turnover requirements.
Include the seller’s 1031 identification date, closing date, Thursday call date, and other operative milestones in a mutually consistent timeline.

Include concise compliance material addressing the federal character of the 1031 deadline, the Illinois situs of the real estate and relevant transaction handling, and the limited Indiana relevance created by the buyer’s location or financing activity.
Include page labels, exhibit labels, message dates, or comparable anchors that permit precise citation.

evidence_relationships: The buyer-demand components must sum exactly to $780,000.

The supported negotiation ceiling is the lowest applicable limit among the buyer’s demand, source-supported current scope, and the seller’s authorized maximum exposure; remedies addressing the same condition cannot be stacked when calculating exposure.
Observed conditions, immediate work, future work, budget allowances, and buyer demands must remain separate categories; a report estimate is not automatically a seller liability.
The 60-day annex right is the seller’s priority term, so the viable sequence preserves monetary or price movement as leverage until that right is executed or simultaneously documented.
The lender-driver conclusion must remain an inference because the bundle contains suggestive communications but no definitive lender directive.
Any enhanced seller remedy must be conditional on reciprocal buyer commitments, must prevent double recovery, and must expire or revert if not accepted under source-consistent timing.
The prior informal promise must be acknowledged and narrowed through accurate clarification; the gold must neither deny the statement nor transform it into an uncapped warranty.

Illinois relevance follows the property situs and supplied transaction-compliance record. Indiana relevance is limited to the buyer or financing connection shown in the source and must not be used to claim that Indiana law governs the Illinois property.
Federal 1031 timing must be distinguished from state-specific transaction considerations, with legal and tax conclusions reserved for qualified specialists.

intended_solution_behavior.position: Produce one integrated, call-ready counter-position that begins by clarifying the requested remedy and testing the financing driver, moves through source-supported lower-cost responses, conditions any meaningful concession on execution of the 60-day annex arrangement and other reciprocal protections, and reserves a capped monetary response for the final authorized stage.
intended_solution_behavior.instructional_quality: A covering broker unfamiliar with the file must be able to identify the opening language, questions, permitted branches, escalation points, authority ceiling, reciprocal terms, and non-negotiable prohibitions without contacting the author.
must_not_claim: That the informal promise established a binding scope, amount, warranty, or admission.
That every report recommendation is an immediate defect or seller obligation.
That Indiana law governs the Illinois real estate merely because the buyer or financing team is based there.
That the memorandum supplies definitive legal, engineering, lender, or tax advice.
intended_solution_behavior.intended_verdict: A strong submission authorizes a single bounded position, preserves the annex leverage through the ordering of concessions, handles the ambiguous term and prior promise professionally, and can be executed by the covering broker under the stated deadline.

gold_construction_checks: Trace every figure, date, quoted statement, and transaction term to the PDF.
Recalculate the buyer-demand total and the maximum aggregate seller exposure.
Confirm that no remedy is counted twice.
Walk every branch to ensure the broker always has a permitted response or a clear stop-and-escalate instruction.
Render the final DOCX and confirm it remains within six pages without clipped or unreadable content.
Review the final paragraph to ensure it ends on the operative authorized position.

reference_files.purpose: Complete mixed-format evidence bundle containing the transaction terms, inspection materials, correspondence, call notes, authority limits, deadline information, leaseback requirements, and jurisdiction-related compliance material needed to prepare the counter-position.
reference_files.discovery: Read the full bundle, including embedded report excerpts, email chains, notes, and transaction summaries.

deliverables.description: A call-ready counter-position and concession-sequence memorandum for owner authorization and compliance review.
constraints: Must be written to the top level of the working directory under the exact filename; must not exceed six pages including tables and appendices; must present one coherent counter-position; all figures, dates, property terms, and report assertions must be traceable to the supplied evidence bundle.

original_instruction:
You are Arjun Fitzgerald, the listing broker advising Reina Whitcombe and Inglewood Board on the sale of the 96,000-square-foot Coldharbour Provisions cold-storage plant in Illinois to Underhill Solutions, whose deal team and financing are based in Indiana. Eleven days before Reina’s 1031 identification deadline, Underhill has re-traded for a $780,000 “credit,” pointing to the refrigeration and roof reports. The timing and pattern of its requests may indicate lender re-underwriting, but nobody has confirmed that, and Reina needs her 60-day use of the loading annex after closing more than she needs to preserve every dollar of headline price. Eamon Kristiansen, who was trying to keep the deal together, has already told Underhill informally that “we’ll make the report items right,” even though neither the scope nor his authority was settled. The word “credit” is also being used in the correspondence to mean both a reduction in purchase price and a seller credit shown at closing, and Jelena Demirci will not approve a position that leaves that ambiguity unresolved. Use the complete transaction record in `coldharbour_transaction_evidence.pdf` to prepare the counter-position and concession sequence Reina can authorize before Thursday’s call. Tell Eamon, who is covering the call and has not previously worked on this transaction, what Inglewood Board will give, the order in which he may give it, what must be obtained in return, where he must stop, and what he must never offer. The memorandum must make one coherent counter-position, address the Illinois and Indiana implications relevant to the transaction without presenting legal or tax advice, and distinguish supported facts from negotiation inferences. Make every monetary figure, date, property term, and report-based assertion traceable to the evidence bundle; do not create estimates or deal terms that are not there. Keep the memorandum to no more than six pages, including any tables or appendices, and make it usable during the call without Eamon having to ask you what to say next. Write the final file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/coldharbour_transaction_evidence.pdf` — Complete mixed-format evidence bundle containing the transaction terms, inspection materials, correspondence, call notes, authority limits, deadline information, leaseback requirements, and jurisdiction-related compliance material needed to prepare the counter-position.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `coldharbour_counterposition_memo.docx` — A call-ready counter-position and concession-sequence memorandum for owner authorization and compliance review. (Must be written to the top level of the working directory under the exact filename; must not exceed six pages including tables and appendices; must present one coherent counter-position; all figures, dates, property terms, and report assertions must be traceable to the supplied evidence bundle.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
